questiontext.text:
A night guard at a warehouse in Nairobi's Industrial Area stands at a fixed point \(O\) and sweeps a searchlight across the compound. The beam reaches a distance of \({@r@}\,\text{m}\) and sweeps through an angle of \({@theta@}^\circ\) as the guard turns.

Calculate the area of the ground illuminated by the searchlight, correct to \(2\,\text{decimal places}\). (Use \(\pi=\frac{22}{7}\))

[[jsxgraph]] var brd = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard('jxgbox', { boundingbox: [-10, 10, 10, -3], axis: false, showNavigation: false, showCopyright: false, keepAspectRatio: true }); // O: the guard's fixed position var O = brd.create('point', [0, -1], { name: 'O', visible: true, size: 2, fixed: true, label: { offset: [-16, -12], fontSize: 16 } }); // Fixed DISPLAY radius, independent of the true r (which is in metres) var displayRadius = 8; var angleDeg = {#theta#}; var angleRad = angleDeg * Math.PI / 180; // Start edge of the sweep (along the ground, roughly horizontal) var P = brd.create('point', [O.X() + displayRadius, O.Y()], {visible: false}); // End edge of the sweep, at the true swept angle var Q = brd.create('point', [ O.X() + displayRadius * Math.cos(angleRad), O.Y() + displayRadius * Math.sin(angleRad) ], {visible: false}); // Illuminated sector (searchlight beam) brd.create('sector', [O, P, Q], { fillColor: '#ffe066', fillOpacity: 0.6, strokeColor: '#e8a500', strokeWidth: 2 }); // Guard's edges of the beam, drawn clearly brd.create('segment', [O, P], {strokeColor: '#e8a500', strokeWidth: 2}); brd.create('segment', [O, Q], {strokeColor: '#e8a500', strokeWidth: 2}); // Angle marker brd.create('angle', [P, O, Q], { radius: 1.5, name: function() { return angleDeg + '°'; } }); // Beam-reach label, along the bisector of the angle brd.create('text', [ function() { return O.X() + (displayRadius * 0.55) * Math.cos(angleRad / 2); }, function() { return O.Y() + (displayRadius * 0.55) * Math.sin(angleRad / 2) + 0.5; }, function() { return {#r#} + ' m'; } ], { fontSize: 14 }); // Small torch/guard icon label near O brd.create('text', [O.X() - 2.2, O.Y() + 0.7, 'Guard']); [[/jsxgraph]]

\(\text{Area of ground illuminated}=\)[[input:ans1]]\(\,\text{m}^2\)[[validation:ans1]][[feedback:prt1]]

generalfeedback.text:
Worked Solution

The illuminated ground forms a sector of a circle, since it is bounded by the two edges of the beam (two radii) and the arc traced as the guard turns. From the problem:

  • Angle swept: \({@theta@}^\circ\)
  • Beam reach (radius): \(r={@r@}\,\text{m}\)

Step 1: Write the formula for the area of a sector.

\[ A = \frac{\theta}{360} \times \pi r^2 \]

Step 2: Substitute the values and compute the area.

\( \begin{align} A &= \frac{{@theta@}}{360} \times \frac{22}{7} \times ({@r@})^2 \\ &= \frac{{@theta@}}{360} \times \frac{22}{7} \times {@r_sq@} \\ &= {@A@}\,\text{m}^2 \end{align} \)

Rounded to \(2\) decimal places:

\(\text{Area of ground illuminated} \approx {@A_2dp@}\,\text{m}^2\)
